```{r}
setwd("/media/fabio/Data/Azores_Maps")

library(lidR); library(terra); library(sf); library(rlas)
library(future)


# --- Setup ---------------------------------------------------------------
#files <- list.files("/media/fabio/Data/Azores_Maps/Angra_LAS",
#                    pattern = "\\.laz$", full.names = TRUE)
#for (f in files) writelax(f)
#### This is only once for indexing and multiprocessing


ctg <- readLAScatalog("/media/fabio/Data/Azores_Maps/Angra_LAS")
st_crs(ctg) <- 5015                      # PTRA08 / UTM zone 26N
is.indexed(ctg)
opt_select(ctg)       <- "xyzc"
opt_filter(ctg)       <- ""              # all returns, so classes can overlap
opt_chunk_buffer(ctg) <- 0
opt_output_files(ctg) <- "tmp/presence_{XLEFT}_{YBOTTOM}"

# 1 = unclassified (used internally only), 2 = ground, 3/4/5 = low/med/high veg,
# 6 = building, 9 = water, 10 = dirt roads, 11 = roads, 26 = bridges
classes <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 26)

# --- Presence/absence per class --------------------------------------------
presence_fun <- function(cls, classes) {
  out <- lapply(classes, function(k) as.integer(any(cls == k)))
  names(out) <- paste0("class_", classes)
  out
}

opt_chunk_size(ctg) <- 500        # good balance between RAM and overhead
plan(multisession, workers = 3)   # or plan(multicore, ...) outside RStudio

pres <- pixel_metrics(ctg, ~presence_fun(Classification, classes), res = 1)

plan(sequential)

for (nm in setdiff(names(pres), "class_1")) {
  writeRaster(pres[[nm]], paste0("presence_", nm, ".tif"),
              datatype = "INT1U", gdal = "COMPRESS=DEFLATE", overwrite = TRUE)
}

# --- Helper: class layer as 0/1, NA treated as 0 ---------------------------
ras_dir <- "/media/fabio/Data/Azores_Maps/Angra_Classes_PA2"

lyr <- function(k) {
  x <- pres[[paste0("class_", k)]]
  ifel(is.na(x), 0, x)
}

g       <- pres[["class_2"]]
g0      <- ifel(is.na(g), 0, g)
veg_unc <- (lyr(1) + lyr(3) + lyr(4) + lyr(5)) > 0
bridge <- lyr(26) == 1

# --- Buildings: core vs. edge ---------------------------------------------
bldg  <- lyr(6) == 1
bcore <- focal(ifel(bldg, 1, 0), w = 3, fun = "min", na.rm = TRUE) == 1   # erode 1 cell
bedge <- bldg & !bcore                       # outer ring: eaves over sidewalks

# --- Roads: only close holes mostly surrounded by road -------------------
road_raw <- (lyr(10) + lyr(11)) > 0
nb_road  <- focal(ifel(road_raw, 1, 0), w = 5, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
road     <- road_raw | (nb_road >= 0.5 & lyr(1) == 1 & g0 == 0)

# --- Fill source: real ground that is not road ----------------------------
barrier <- road | bcore | bridge
src <- ifel(g0 == 1 & !road, 1, NA)
for (i in 1:10) {
  src <- focal(src, w = 3, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE, na.policy = "only")
  src <- mask(src, barrier, maskvalues = 1)
}

# --- Assemble ground layer -------------------------------------------------
eligible <- (g0 == 0) & (veg_unc | bedge) & !bcore & !road & !bridge
ground <- ifel(eligible & !is.na(src), 1, g0)
ground <- ifel(bcore | road, 0, ground)      # bridges keep measured ground beneath
ground <- mask(ground, g)

writeRaster(ground, file.path(ras_dir, "presence_ground_soil_filled.tif"),
            datatype = "INT1U", gdal = "COMPRESS=DEFLATE", overwrite = TRUE)


#plan(sequential)                 # shuts down any parallel workers
#rm(list = ls())                  # remove all objects (or rm(pres, g, ...) for specific ones)
#gc()                             # free the memory
#terra::tmpFiles(remove = TRUE)   # delete terra's temporary files


```

Building height map

```{r}
library(lidR); library(terra); library(sf); library(future)

ctg <- readLAScatalog("/media/fabio/Data/Azores_Maps/Angra_LAS")
st_crs(ctg) <- 5015
opt_select(ctg)     <- "xyzc"
opt_chunk_size(ctg) <- 500

plan(multisession, workers = 3)      # or plan(multicore, ...) outside RStudio

# --- 1. Ground surface (DTM) ---------------------------------------------
opt_filter(ctg)       <- "-keep_class 2"
opt_chunk_buffer(ctg) <- 20
opt_output_files(ctg) <- "tmp/dtm_{XLEFT}_{YBOTTOM}"
dtm <- rasterize_terrain(ctg, res = 1, algorithm = tin())

# --- 2. Building top surface ---------------------------------------------
opt_filter(ctg)       <- "-keep_class 6"
opt_chunk_buffer(ctg) <- 0
opt_output_files(ctg) <- "tmp/bdsm_{XLEFT}_{YBOTTOM}"
bdsm <- pixel_metrics(ctg, ~max(Z), res = 1)

plan(sequential)                     # shut down workers, free their RAM

if (!compareGeom(bdsm, dtm, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
  bdsm <- resample(bdsm, dtm, method = "near")
}

# --- 3. Building height per pixel ----------------------------------------
bh <- bdsm - dtm
bh <- ifel(bh < 0, 0, bh)            # clamp small negative values from noise

writeRaster(bh, "building_height.tif",
            datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = "COMPRESS=DEFLATE", overwrite = TRUE)
```
